# scaffolding_node_disks (Data Source)

Lists the physical disks attached to a Proxmox VE node (`GET /nodes/{node}/disks/list`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Name of the PVE node to query.

### Optional

- `include_smart` (Boolean) When `true`, fetch SMART data per disk and merge the `health` field onto the rows. Defaults to `false`.
- `wwn` (String) Optional substring filter on the disk WWN.

### Read-Only

- `disks` (Attributes List) Disks matching the filter (or all disks when no filter is set). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--disks))
- `id` (String) Static identifier equal to the node name.

<a id="nestedatt--disks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `disks`

Read-Only:

- `devpath` (String) Device path (e.g. `/dev/sda`).
- `gpt` (Boolean) True when the disk carries a GPT partition table.
- `health` (String) SMART health (populated when `include_smart=true`); one of `PASSED`, `FAILED`, or `UNKNOWN`.
- `model` (String) Model string.
- `mounted` (Boolean) True when the disk has at least one mounted filesystem.
- `osdid` (Number) OSD identifier if the disk participates in Ceph.
- `parent` (String) Parent device path (for partitions).
- `serial` (String) Serial number.
- `type` (String) Disk type. One of `ssd`, `hdd`, or `nvme`.
- `used` (String) PVE usage label. One of `root`, `unused`, `zfs`, `lvm`, `lvmthin`, `ceph`, or `directory`.
- `vendor` (String) Vendor string.
- `wwn` (String) World Wide Name.
